title: GitHub Repository Weekly Open Issues Trend
dataSources: GitHub repositories (`github:repo`), commits (`github:commit`), issues (`github:issue`), and releases (`github:release`).
app: GitHub repository metadata, commit activity feeds, issue trackers, and release publish logs forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=github:repo open_issues=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(open_issues) as avg_duration, max(open_issues) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst open issues for GitHub repository events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture open_issues on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average open issues with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks whether GitHub repository tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
